provenance: Telephone call, 2026-09-01 — the same call as the four probe answers. Asked of VN-0153, the photograph of the python: "Did they eat it?" Larry's son reported the answer afterwards, in his own words and in the third person, by annotating the interview guide (research/interviews/breakfast-questions.md). Recorded here 2026-09-02.
text: My father said they did and it tasted delicious.
researchNotes: Answers the standing question on VN-0153. Filed as paraphrase because the voice is third-person ("My father said"), which this archive treats as the giveaway regardless of where the facts came from. Small, and worth having anyway: it is the first thing anyone has established about VN-0153, which is otherwise uncataloged with an unknown date, and it is the kind of detail — a snake eaten, and enjoyed — that only the man in the photograph can supply. It does not date or place the photograph, and nothing here should be read as doing so.
